about.title: About Promos 2012
paragraphs: Promos 2012 gathers the 33 promo cards from 25 products released in 2012: Abyss Rising: Special Edition, Abyss Rising Sneak Peek Participation Card, Duel Terminal 6, Duel Terminal 7, Galactic Overlord Sneak Peek Participation Card, Hidden Arsenal 5: Steelswarm Invasion: Special Edition, Shonen Jump Vol. 10, Issue 1 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 10, Issue 3 promotional card, Shonen Jump Vol. 10, Issue 4 promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump Alpha April 2012 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump Alpha July 2012 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump Alpha September 2012 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump Alpha December 2012 membership promotional card, Legendary Collection 3: Yugi's World, Order of Chaos: Special Edition, Order of Chaos Sneak Peek Participation Card, Return of the Duelist: Special Edition, Return of the Duelist Sneak Peek Participation Card, Ra Yellow Mega Pack: Special Edition, Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series 2012 Prize Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Volume 2 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Volume 3 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Volume 8 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL Volume 1 promotional card and Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL Volume 2 promotional card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 33 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 34, adding the 1 other rarity).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
